title.narrative: Desarrollo de capacidades organizativas de la sociedad civil

description.narrative: (Ecuador): .Investigative journalism in Ecuador has been instrumental in exposing corruption, yet the sector faces significant challenges that hinder its impact. Journalists and media outlets often work without adequate financial, technical, legal, or institutional support, leaving them vulnerable to threats-especially when uncovering activities involving criminal organizations or powerful individuals. These vulnerabilities limit the ability of investigative journalism to hold institutions accountable and inform the public effectively..USAID will bolster transparency and accountability advancing investigative journalism, particularly at the local level. USAID will strengthen investigative networks, improve the financial and operational sustainability of media outlets, and implement measures to protect journalists' safety and security. USAID will expand access to engaging, high-quality investigative reporting that exposes crime and corruption, amplify public awareness and hold government institutions accountable, creating a culture of transparency and civic engagement...USAID will enhance the resilience of the investigative journalism sector, increasing its financial and management capacity. Freelance journalists and journalism students will develop their skills, while civil society, academia, and the private sector will join forces with local media to support investigative reporting...USAID will improve how investigative content is shared and consumed, ensuring that critical issues reach wider audiences and inspire public discourse on corruption and accountability. Safety and security measures will enable journalists to work without fear to continue their vital role...USAID will empower investigative journalists, transforming the sector into a cornerstone of democracy, transparency, and public trust. This initiative will create a robust, sustainable, and impactful investigative journalism landscape......... .... .

Fortalecer la capacidad organizativa de las Organizaciones de la Sociedad Civil (OSC) para el análisis y la supervisión de políticas, la promoción, la formación de coaliciones, la gobernanza interna, la representación y los servicios de los miembros, y la prestación de servicios sostenibles que satisfagan consistentemente las necesidades, prioridades y expectativas de sus electores y comunidades. Las áreas de desarrollo de capacidades pueden incluir, entre otras, experiencia técnica (por ejemplo, democracia, reforma legal, estándares de atención); Autorregulación de las OSC (por ejemplo, establecimiento de códigos de conducta de las OSC); capacidad organizacional (por ejemplo, planificación estratégica, gestión financiera y rendición de cuentas, relaciones públicas y extensión, generación de ingresos, recaudación de fondos responsable, relaciones con los electores, servicios a los miembros, gestión de relaciones, aprendizaje y adaptación); y capacitación en promoción.
